shared_elements: bearded male figure with elaborately curled/patterned hair and beard
low-relief carved figures against plain ground
figure holding a long staff/spear-like object
bracelet/armlet with rosette or disc on the wrist
patterned pleated robe with vertical striations
justification: Both show bearded male figures in strict profile, carved in low relief on a plain ground, wearing long vertically pleated garments, with tightly curled stylised hair and beard rendered as rows of regular curls, holding a long upright staff/spear and wearing rosette-set wrist bands \u2014 a highly specific and conventional combination. The main differences are that B is a single large winged figure occupying the whole panel with a raised hand and pine-cone-like object, whereas A shows a horizontal file of repeated wingless attendants in a processional band.
